content_sections.heading: Gorakhpur Anganwadi Worker Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Only female candidates are eligible to apply for these posts. The candidate must be a resident of the same Gram Sabha (for rural posts) or the same ward of the urban area (for urban posts) against which the vacancy exists - this residency condition is mandatory. If no eligible candidate is available in a particular category within a Gram Sabha, category-wise selection will be made from the concerned Nyaya Panchayat (adjoining panchayat circle). Widowed applicants must submit their husband's death certificate and a copy of the family register, certified by the Gram Panchayat Officer or the concerned urban local body. In cases of divorce or desertion, only a valid order issued by a competent court will be accepted as proof.

content_sections.heading: Gorakhpur Anganwadi Karyakatri Qualification
content_sections.text: The minimum educational qualification prescribed for the post of Anganwadi Karyakatri is Intermediate (12th pass) or an equivalent qualification. Where more than one eligible candidate is available in the same category for a post, a merit list will be prepared among all eligible applicants, and the merit will be finalised giving weight to the highest educational qualification held, up to postgraduate level.

content_sections.heading: Gorakhpur Anganwadi Karyakatri Age Limit
content_sections.text: Candidates should ensure that they meet the prescribed age limit as on the specified cut-off date. You can use our Age Calculator to check your exact age and confirm your eligibility before applying.

content_sections.heading: Gorakhpur Anganwadi Karyakatri Selection Process
content_sections.text: The entire selection process for the advertised posts will be conducted online through the departmental portal, following the procedure laid down in Government Order No. 1/1092245/2025/3313/58-1-2025(1917687) dated 17 September 2025. No written examination or interview will be conducted for this recruitment. Where multiple eligible candidates exist in the same category for the same post, selection will be based on a merit list prepared according to educational qualification, as described under Qualification above.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Gorakhpur Anganwadi Karyakatri Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Visit the official departmental portal: upanganwadibharti.in. Locate and open the online application form for Anganwadi Karyakatri recruitment for the relevant Child Development Project area in Gorakhpur district. Fill in all required details in the online form carefully and accurately. Upload self-attested, clear, and readable copies of the documents specified in the online application form. (The notification does not list the individual documents; the exact list appears on the application form itself.) Verify all entered details - including income, caste, and residence certificate particulars - since these will be verified online through the portal, and any incorrect entry may lead to automatic rejection of the application. Submit the application online before the last date, 5 October 2026 (12:00 midnight). Applications will be accepted only through the online portal - no offline, postal, or courier applications will be accepted. Domicile and caste certificates will be accepted only if issued online with digital signature by the Tehsil. Income certificates must be issued by the competent Revenue Department authority as per Government Order No. 3959/1-9-11-Raja-9 dated 30.09.2011 (as amended). Per the Social Welfare Department order dated 14.09.2015 (as amended), the annual family income ceiling referenced is Rs. 46,080 for rural areas and Rs. 56,460 for urban areas.

content_sections.heading: Important Notes
content_sections.text: The village/ward-wise vacancy and reservation details are displayed at the offices of the Child Development Project, Block Development Officer, Primary Health Centre, Tehsil, District Programme Officer, Chief Medical Officer, Chief Development Officer, and District Magistrate. The number of vacancies may increase or decrease; any revision will be shown on the official website. Candidates are cautioned against falling for the temptations or lures of touts/middlemen during the selection process, as the entire process is online and free of any such involvement.

faq.question: Q1. What is Gorakhpur Anganwadi Karyakatri Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a recruitment drive by the Office of the District Programme Officer, Gorakhpur, to fill 326 honorarium-based Anganwadi Karyakatri (Anganwadi Worker) posts across 20 Child Development Project areas in Gorakhpur district, for women candidates only.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available?
faq.answer: 326 vacancies in total, split as 67 for SC/ST, 95 for OBC, and 164 unreserved, across 20 project areas.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The last date to apply online is 5 October 2026, up to 12:00 midnight.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required?
faq.answer: The minimum qualification is Intermediate (12th pass) or equivalent.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: Candidates must be between 18 and 35 years of age, calculated as on 1 July 2026.

faq.question: Q6. How can I apply online?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted online through the official portal, upanganwadibharti.in; no offline or postal applications are accepted.
